55227.x: A busy household collects mess in more than one way. Some builds up slowly across the whole home, while some arrives suddenly in a single spot.
Cleanix Robotics Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in two categories, Home Appliances and Smart Home, at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for xLean TR1, a floor washing robot.

The product is described as the world's first dual-form transformable floor washing robot. It switches between robot form and handheld form in one second, so a single device handles fully autonomous whole-home cleaning and the cleanup of unexpected messes.

Dual-Motor DirectSuction technology lets xLean TR1 handle large spills, mixed wet-dry messes and stubborn stains, a level of performance the description says no other cleaning robot on the market currently delivers.
A Robot Evolution Learning Algorithm brings reinforcement learning into the robot, allowing it to improve continuously through real-world interaction instead of relying on fixed behavior rules.

55229.x: A finished video usually passes through many hands, from the first plan to the last round of notes. Feedback tends to arrive as comments about a specific moment or object on screen.
ELBA Corp. was named a 2027 Honoree in Content & Entertainment at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for YouViCo: End-to-End AI Video Workflow, Directed by Visual Feedback.

YouViCo runs the whole video workflow, from brief, plan, generate, edit, review, fix and approve through delivery, on one AI agent platform. Given a one-line brief, YouViCo Agent writes the plan and shot list, generates assets with 20+ built-in image, video, music and 3D models, cuts them on the timeline, and checks loudness, color and clipping before anyone watches.

Notes are given by showing. Clients open one link and draw on the frame, and the agent reads each mark and makes pinpoint edits to that object or area, such as a logo or a hand, without regenerating the shot. Every comment and approval stays in one place through final delivery.

Designed for full automation, the agent works in the background, and only deleting, spending credits and sharing wait for human approval. Built by a media company with 3 million+ subscribers, YouViCo runs on web, desktop and mobile.

55230.x: A child's growth check and an older adult's bone-health checkup have little in common on the surface. Both, however, come down to reading the condition of the skeleton.
GEMSS Healthcare Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for XPLUS microTOMO, a mobile all-in-one X-ray system.

The system integrates four capabilities: real-time low-dose C-arm imaging, rotation-free 3D tomosynthesis, AI-assisted BMD screening for adults and older adults, and AI-assisted bone-age analysis for children and adolescents.

For musculoskeletal imaging and procedures, it provides real-time 2D fluoroscopy. When depth information is needed, only the X-ray source moves linearly to acquire multi-angle projections, without rotating the C-arm around the patient, and the projections are reconstructed into 3D tomosynthesis images available for review within 45 seconds.

Life-stage-specific AI analysis supports different bone-health needs. Hand X-rays of adults and older adults are analyzed for bone-density-related information to support low-BMD screening, while those of children and adolescents are analyzed for bone age and skeletal maturity to support growth assessment and treatment planning.

55231.x: Human hands adjust their grip without conscious effort, from lifting an egg to turning a key. Robots that handle objects have to account for the same range, from gentle to firm.
Hangzhou Xynova Technology Co., Ltd was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Xynova Prima 1, a dexterous hand.

Prima 1 is a 22-DoF, fully direct-drive dexterous hand built for embodied AI research and scalable deployment. It delivers millisecond-level response, precise force control and five-finger visuo-tactile sensing.

Advanced thermal management and engineering-grade durability ensure sustained performance in continuous operation. Together, these capabilities make the hand a versatile platform for AI engineers working on embodied AI development, including robotic imitation learning and Sim-to-Real policy transfer.

55232.x: Family life is full of small routines, from morning conversation to evening chores. A new member of the household, even a machine, would have to fit into them.
JOYIN TECHNOLOGY was named a 2027 Honoree in Smart Home at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for ZEROTH Bridge.

Bridge is a humanoid robot designed to bring physical AI into everyday family life. It combines a compact, family-friendly robot with OpenBridge, an ecosystem where robotic skills are continuously trained, refined and shared within a growing community of users.

As a companion, Bridge responds to a family member's tone and mood through natural body language, and it can move and interact on its own or be teleoperated hands-on through VR headsets or hand controllers.

Every skill Bridge learns can be shared back into OpenBridge, helping other Bridge robots grow more capable over time. By unifying a safe, approachable robot with a continuously evolving AI ecosystem, the description says, Bridge and OpenBridge bring physical AI within reach of everyday households.

55235.x: Taking a temperature is a familiar routine in many homes. It is often the first check made when a child seems unwell.

Otiton Medical, a digital healthcare startup, won Innovation Awards in two categories at CES 2027, earning recognition for both technological innovation and marketability and demonstrating its differentiated technology on the global stage.

The Otiton Smart Therapy Device helps users care for and treat ear health safely and easily at home, without a hospital visit. By guiding patient-specific treatment and offering intuitive usability, it was credited with setting a new standard for home healthcare.

The second winner, the AI Snermi Smart Thermometer, combines precise temperature measurement with ear canal (inner ear) monitoring. A built-in camera and an AI analysis algorithm detect early signs of abnormalities through everyday monitoring at home, which maximizes the convenience of managing ear, nose and throat conditions in infants and young children as well as chronic cases.
In January 2027, the company will attend CES 2027 in Las Vegas, where it will present both products to global buyers and visitors as it speeds up its entry into global markets.

55236.x: Blood pressure is usually measured with an inflatable cuff wrapped around the upper arm. A reading taken that way captures a single moment rather than a full day.
United Sensing and MediTech Limited was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for πRing.

πRing is described as the world's first cuffless blood pressure monitoring smart ring. Equipped with high-precision PPG, ECG and temperature sensors and an accelerometer, it enables tracking of blood pressure, ECG, heart rate, SpO₂, HRV, sleep staging and physical activity in an unobtrusive ring form factor.

The ring is integrated with Dr. PAI, described as the world's first personalized AI doctor for hypertension management, trained on 100 thousand one-minute segments, each enclosing ECG and simultaneously highly sampled multi-wavelength PPG. Together they deliver a closed-loop service from intelligent symptom inquiry and real-time monitoring to precise assessment and personalized intervention.

Built on 23 years of original research and aligned with IEEE 1708, the international standard for wearable cuffless BP devices, πRing is currently under NMPA and FDA regulatory review. It addresses the needs of hypertensive patients, cardiovascular high-risk individuals, elderly care recipients and chronic disease management populations, offering medical-grade data continuity for proactive health management.

55238.x: Most screens stay where they are put, on a desk, a wall or a lap. Anything meant to be used while walking around has to be carried or worn.
XREAL was named a 2027 Honoree in XR & Spatial Computing at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for XREAL AURA, an optical see-through XR headset.

AURA weighs under 95 grams and is built to make everyday spatial computing wearable rather than a seated, isolated experience. A dual-chip split-compute architecture separates processing by task: the XREAL X1S Spatial Coprocessor, embedded in the frame, handles low-latency spatial display and sensor processing locally, while an external Snapdragon Reality Elite unit manages heavier computation.

This lets the headset support 6DoF positional tracking and hand tracking without a companion controller, and deliver a 70-degree field-of-view display without the weight typically required for that level of capability.

Running Google's Android XR operating system, AURA integrates Gemini AI on-device for real-time, multimodal, conversational interactions rather than relying solely on the cloud. Its developer ecosystem, built through the Android XR Catalyst Developer Program, supports cross-play titles like Demeo across Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro, PlayStation VR2 and PICO, extending beyond a single closed platform.

55239.x: A yard asks for different work in different seasons, from cutting grass in summer to clearing snow in winter. Each of those jobs usually calls for a separate tool.

Yarbo International Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Smart Home at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Yarbo M Series, a compact modular outdoor robotics platform designed for small to mid-sized yards.
Built around one universal core with interchangeable modules for mowing, trimming, snow removal and towing, the M Series enables year-round outdoor maintenance with fewer tools.

Compared with Yarbo's larger Y Series, it is optimized for standard residential environments. LiDAR-powered navigation, Data Center Gen2 and NetRTK service provide enhanced positioning and spatial awareness in tighter yard layouts.

Setup takes about 30 minutes, and wireless fast charging is up to three times faster than many conventional systems. The Yarbo Open Platform also lets users customize and expand new outdoor applications.

55240.x: Ports, warehouses and construction sites are busy places where large vehicles share space with people and other equipment. Operators in those places have to watch several directions at once.
Zadar Labs Inc was named a 2027 Honoree in Construction & Industrial Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Zadar360° 4D Radar Collision-Warning System.

Zadar360° is a collision-warning system designed for industrial and commercial vehicles operating in complex environments such as ports, warehouses, construction sites, mines and agricultural facilities. It combines multiple 4D imaging radars with a central processing unit that fuses radar data, tracks surrounding objects, predicts vehicle path and alerts operators when an object presents a genuine collision risk.

Unlike optical sensing systems, the radar-based architecture is designed to operate in challenging conditions including darkness, rain, fog, dust and glare. The system is vehicle-agnostic and can be configured for a wide range of equipment, including forklifts, cranes, straddle carriers, loaders, haul trucks, buses and other heavy vehicles.

By providing continuous 360-degree situational awareness and reducing unnecessary warnings, Zadar360° helps improve operator awareness, workplace safety and operational efficiency across diverse industrial applications.

55241.x: A video production involves many roles, from planning on set to editing and client review. Each role works with its own piece of the footage and its own notes.
Zonic received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Filmmaking & Distribution, in partnership with Cannes Next, at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Zonic Editorial Intelligence.

Zonic Editorial Intelligence is an AI-native collaboration pipeline for video production, bringing planning, directing, cinematography, editing and client review into one shared production context. Its long-term multimodal memory connects footage, transcripts, creative intent, decisions and feedback across roles and stages.

Human experts and role-based AI agents work from this context to understand source material, guide capture, assemble editable sequences and carry revisions through delivery. Zonic continuously improves through human expert-AI interaction: professionals direct it in language, revise cuts and review results, while Zonic retains the context and lessons from those interactions.

Editorial decisions remain traceable to recorded material, and sequences can be exported for continued work in professional editing software. With broadcast-grade capabilities used by television customers, Zonic also supports live capture and editing, helping teams coordinate complex production workflows while preserving human creative direction.
